scope: GenAI Engine 16K MTP proposal-budget sweep and refreshed-main WebGPU attempts; no native kernel changes.

methodology.prefill_chunk_and_scheduling_budget: 256 for proposal sweep and WebGPU; 1024 for the two separately labeled chunk/selected-head checks.
methodology.caveat: One measured repetition after three warmups per mode, fixed order and external system activity limit causal/statistical speedup claims. Keep every warmup and decode interval. An incomplete WebGPU attempt provides no throughput comparison.
methodology.ownership_and_sharing: MLX uses GenAI CPU-owned state and disables shared-initializer metadata because GenAI0.19 CPU GetMemoryInfo throws. WebGPU uses its proper device interface and original builder initializer sharing. Both load the identical original ONNX graphs and external weights; do not force WebGPU to duplicate working shared weights.

mlx_k4.proposal_limit_reporting: GenAI's max_draft_tokens_per_proposal reports the export capacity (4). The requested runtime limit is recorded in runtime_overlay.speculative; actual draft/round counts and acceptance histograms are also checked.

mlx_selected_k1_chunk1024.proposal_limit_reporting: GenAI's max_draft_tokens_per_proposal reports the export capacity (4). The requested runtime limit is recorded in runtime_overlay.speculative; actual draft/round counts and acceptance histograms are also checked.
mlx_selected_k1_chunk1024.model_interface: Explicit separate selected-logits ONNX variant, with Gather before the unchanged quantized LM head; not an unchanged-export EP comparison.

webgpu_k1.proposal_limit_reporting: GenAI's max_draft_tokens_per_proposal reports the export capacity (4). The requested runtime limit is recorded in runtime_overlay.speculative; actual draft/round counts and acceptance histograms are also checked.

selected_head_interpretation: All tokens and speculative counters match the original-export K1/chunk1024 control. Selected-head TTFT is lower but measured decode is slower; no production rewrite or default model-interface change is retained.

webgpu_source.configuration: Release, arm64, LTO; clean source build, original device-backed WebGPU alias and original initializer-sharing metadata.
webgpu_source.runtime: Matching-ABI imported ORT1.32.0 runtime retained from prior source build; plugin rebuilt from the stated refreshed main commit.

mlx_build.note: The retained binary was built before #130 committed its source changes. Its source hashes and binary hash are unchanged throughout this sweep.

webgpu_initial_attempt.status: Stopped by the 40-minute orchestration deadline after three completed warmups, before a final measurement. This is a timeout-bound failure, not an operator error or a throughput result.

webgpu_k4_pressure_observation.scope: One system-level sample after the retry's second warmup, not process-exclusive accounting or proof of a causal slowdown.
webgpu_k4_pressure_observation.note: RSS omits substantial GPU/IOKit allocation ownership. This M1 Max has 32 GiB, not the externally reported M4 Pro's 64 GiB; do not extrapolate throughput or claim its 20.79 tok/s result was reproduced.

k1.caveat: Same graph, weights, prompt, capacity, scheduling and proposal limit, but backend-specific ownership/residency and initializer-sharing configuration. Any token mismatch prevents an exact-output throughput-win claim; one measured repetition is not statistically robust.
